name: Crab Xec Xec
instructions: 1. Clean the crabs thoroughly, remove the apron and gills, and crack the claws for easier eating. 2. Dry roast the coriander seeds, cumin, peppercorns, and dried red chillies until fragrant, then grind into a smooth paste along with the grated coconut, ginger, garlic, and tamarind. 3. Heat coconut oil in a pan, add chopped onions, and sauté until translucent. 4. Stir in the ground masala paste and cook until the oil begins to separate. 5. Add the crabs and turmeric powder, tossing gently to coat them in the masala. 6. Add a little water to adjust consistency, add salt, and cover to cook on low heat until the crabs turn opaque and cooked through. 7. Garnish with fresh curry leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or poee bread.
description: Crab Xec Xec is a quintessential Goan curry that highlights the state's love for fresh seafood and aromatic spice blends. The name 'Xec Xec' comes from the Konkani word 'xec' meaning 'to dry roast,' referring to the specific preparation of the coconut masala. It is a staple dish in Goan households and beach shacks, prized for its complex, spicy, and tangy coconut-based gravy.
